specific_qualification_issues.detail: Parent main field plus bounded accent explicitly defines field/accent prominence. The approved visual_hierarchy role adds composition scope beyond the currently declared color-only effects; native refinement should scope layout.hierarchy.main_field_accent to the main field and bounded accent, without an exact ratio or read-order requirement.

The mandatory parent yarn-pattern and interlacing components establish texture/material scope, while current effects are appearance only. Native refinement should target surface.texture.pattern_yarn_relation and interlacing on the swimsuit patterned textile. Garment-detail source tagging does not prove an additional construction role or manufacturing process.

Parent required spatial gaps directly establish a composition role, although current effects declare color only. Scope layout.spacing.visible_gaps to distinct repeated color owners; do not invent participant numbers, relationship intimacy or reflected duplicates.

Parent required subject layered against dark field establishes composition as well as local color. Native effects currently declare color only; scope layout.subject_field.layering without a physical depth or output-black-floor grading inference.

Parent same cloth color across matte/lustrous woven areas directly preserves color as well as material texture/optical response. Native effects currently declare material only. Add color.hue.same_cloth_color for the damask motif areas; no fiber chemistry or historical claim.

Parent required light subject layered against light field establishes composition alongside color, while current effects declare color only. Scope layout.subject_field.layering and retain local tonal separation without claiming a lighting cause.

Parent cropped-top underbust extent establishes a garment-owned silhouette_proportion role. Current effects declare appearance only; proposed body_geometry refinement is wardrobe.silhouette.cropped_extent on the top, never wearer anatomical proportion.

Parent positively names a focal region made more chromatic than its surrounding field. The approved visual_hierarchy role adds composition scope beyond current color-only effects; scope layout.hierarchy.chroma_focal_region without importing optional example objects or read-order duties.

Optional member cand_bc8ae5c25b655d83873646929f029482 under bind_bc8ae5c25b655d83873646929f029482 names colored sheer superposition and material/color context. Parent cand_1f5286a21ec95b9cb8da7909ce7e78a4 requires only distinguishable layer ends/overlap zones plus same-subject-and-garment co-realization of overlapping fabrics. Therefore the approved parent role is wardrobe_layering only; no mandatory member-color or sheer-property omission, no validator bug, and no pending status.
